IntroCard.title: Crack the code. <accent>Master</accent> the clues.
IntroCard.description: One secret code, four unique digits, and ten attempts. Every guess brings you closer to victory.

Game.reminder: One digit per case · no repetition
Game.advice: Keep the Ts in place and move the Vs around on your next attempt
Game.attemptsHint: The {total} lines are visible until the end of the game.
Game.title: Your move
Game.abandonText: Le code vous sera révélé et la partie comptera comme abandonnée.

Rules.title: 4 Digits
Rules.subtitle: The Pasture Code
Rules.description: Crack the secret code by submitting digit combinations. Pay attention to the clues given after each guess:

bull.label: Bull
bull.description: Correct digit, exactly in the right spot.

cow.label: Cow
cow.description: Correct digit, but placed elsewhere in the code.

instructions: No duplicate digits allowed in the guess.
You have a limited number of attempts to find the code.

success.label: Code déchiffré
success.title: Quel flair !
success.subtitle: Quatre Taureaux en seulement {count} essais. Le pâturage n'avait aucun secret pour vous.

fail.label: Dix essais écoulés
fail.title: Le code s'est échappé.
fail.subtitle: Vous étiez tout près. Analysez les derniers indices et repartez pour une nouvelle enquête.
